MLforSEO Academy · The AI-powered Entity Audit

Entity Brief Generator

Turn audit findings into a brief a writer can act on: canonical name, entities to add, entities to demote, and the placements that matter.

What you need
An Anthropic API key
Cost
Pennies per brief
Feed it
One page's audit row, plus the current page content
You get back
A structured brief you can print or export

How to use it

  1. Paste your Anthropic key and fill in the audit row for one page.
  2. Add the missing entities from your gap matrix and the canonical name.
  3. Paste the current content — the brief is an edit instruction, not a commission.
  4. Read the brief, and check every factual claim it moved or kept.
  5. Export it. It goes to a writer, not to a publish button.

Worth knowing. Never auto-publish a rewrite of a page that carries factual claims or currently ranks well.
